result:
The decisive mistake was at Step 3, when Video_Analyst_Expert fabricated search results. The agent had no search or viewing tool, yet it listed a video titled "Dinosaurs in VR - Narrated by Andy Serkis (360 VR | March 2018)" as if it had found it. It then said it would watch that video manually. This invented video became the basis for everything that followed. Narration_Expert and Verification_Expert then reported a "65 million" figure, which the correct answer (100000000) shows to be wrong. Neither expert had any means of watching the video, so their reports were not real observations.

AGENT: Video_Analyst_Expert
STEP: 3
